Commercial job: Flagship month: win on excitement and economics. Every offer is tied to a game or event, cash discounts stay ≤20% (25% only on annuals), and value comes from upgrades (Cloud Nine 9-month, Club Nine annuals) and buyers who stay after April.

Upgrade: Cloud Nine Limited Edition (“Nine years. Nine months. Nine freezes. Plus one month on us.”). Kwality's 1M average ticket is ₹16,030; this is ₹1.65L upfront. Renewal: Spin Class (Literally) (“Renew, then spin. Every spin wins.”). April 2026 discount depth was 20.4% at Kwality and 20.6% at Bandra on blanket codes. A sure 10% plus a game worth ~9% keeps the average 1M ticket near ₹18,000 instead of ~₹14,000.

Newcomer: Party Crasher Pass (“It's our 9th birthday and you're invited. 3 classes for ₹999.”). 3+ visits convert 73–94%. A paid pass filters no-shows (free trials have no attendance data); crediting it plus the standard 15% lands exactly at a 20% effective discount.

Commercial job: Winback month: manager calls for high-value lapsed clients, fast comebacks for recent lapsers; a results-guarantee bundle; lock 3M plans before the festive dip.
